title: Ikram Khan thanking Khawrai Falahi Committee UAE
caption: It was a moment of pride when the Khawrai Falahi Committee raised funds to handle a death case, ensuring the prompt repatriation of the deceased’s body to his family and completing all necessary procedures.

title: Wonderful gathering of Khawrai Falahi Committee Members
caption: A memorable and heartwarming gathering of Khawrai Falahi Committee members brought everyone together in a spirit of unity, cooperation, and shared purpose. The event highlighted the strong bond among members, providing an opportunity to reconnect, exchange ideas, and celebrate collective achievements. Filled with meaningful conversations, smiles, and a sense of community, the gathering reflected the committee’s ongoing commitment to service, collaboration, and progress.

title: New Changes in constitution
caption: New changes was suggested and the bill was submitted to committee's leadership, was later approved.

title: Formation Of New Cabinet
caption: New cabinet was formated and designations were assigned according to rules and regulations mentioned in the constitution of Khawrai Falahi Committee UAE.

title: Official Committee Meeting with Mir Nawaz Kaji
caption: A renewed effort toward unity within the UAE. Working to build stronger, transparent leadership for a better future.
